item.title: 51 Unhinged And Hilarious Apology Notes
item.description: Singing "You gotta go and get – eh, sorry" on your local X Factor isn't the only way to apologize. Sure, the "Sorry guy" Jonatanas demonstrated that it's a pretty good way to go viral, but it hardly will get someone to forgive you. The folks who wrote these apology notes didn't go viral, but they had the recipients cracking up nonetheless. Check out these "Sorrys" that almost turned the apology into an art form.

item.title: 90 Times People Spotted A Face In An Everyday Thing And Just Had To Share (New Pics)
item.description: It only takes two dots and a curve for our brains to shout “face!” From startled-looking houses to smiling appliances, we’re wired to spot familiar patterns everywhere. The Things With Faces community celebrates these accidental expressions in the wild.

item.title: 84 Fascinating Photos Of Abandoned Places Frozen In Time
item.description: If horror movies have taught me anything, it’s that nothing good ever happens in an abandoned building. But that doesn’t stop people from being curious about them. And apparently, many of them are just begging to be explored. Here’s a list of photos of abandoned buildings, cities, and locations that you might just want to check out for yourself.

item.title: 69 Ridiculous Ideas That Somehow Worked Perfectly
item.description: People can sometimes come up with an idea that may seem absurd when you hear them bring it up. Yet, through some twist of fate, they manage to make it work like a charm, making them appear like geniuses as you stare at them, dumbfounded. This was a discussion in a recent Reddit thread, and here are the top responses.

item.title: 73 Archaeological Finds That Are Downright Creepy
item.description: Archaeology isn’t just pottery shards and treasure. Sometimes, digging into the past uncovers grim reminders of how people once lived, and then perished. Internet users shared the most haunting discoveries they’ve come across, and a few of them are not for the faint of heart.

item.title: 68 Wildly Questionable Thrift Store Treasures That Feel Like They Escaped Another Dimension
item.description: Thrifting for clothes, home décor, and even quirky collectibles is becoming more and more popular lately. After all, it’s cheap, it’s sustainable, and it’s a slap in the face of fast fashion. But, there’s another reason people have taken a liking to second-hand shops: the weird, unhinged finds. Whether it’s a haunted-looking pair of dolls or a vomit clock (yes, it really looks like it’s made with puke), Bored Panda has shortlisted some of the craziest thrift store discoveries that will make you

item.title: 48 Adorably Silly Images Of Italian Greyhounds That Prove Why Everyone Is Obsessed With Them
item.description: One moment, they are a vision of pure, aerodynamic grace. The next, they've completely forgotten how their legs work and are now tangled in a blanket. This is the glorious duality of the Italian greyhound. A wholesome online thread is celebrating this unique breed's talent for being both majestic and a complete doofus, all at the same time. The full gallery of these adorable iggies is in the article

item.title: 45 Times People Who Work With The Dead Were Disgusted, Creeped Out And Frightened
item.description: Autopsies often do far more than confirm how someone died; they expose hidden injuries, buried secrets, and details no one expected to find. In some cases, what’s discovered in the morgue reshapes entire investigations and changes the story completely. This collection dives into moments when examiners uncovered unsettling truths, revealing some chilling and unforgettable things witnessed behind the scenes.

item.title: Mom Gives Up Daughter For Adoption, Returns 15 Years Later When Her Kidneys And Liver Are Failing
item.description: Some absentee parents have the sense of entitlement to suddenly barge into their biological children’s lives. The story you’re about to read is slightly worse, as the mom, who was in poor health, wanted her daughter to donate some of her vital organs. The young girl refused, leading to a tense and chaotic situation for everyone involved.

item.title: Man Upset SIL Is Evicting Him And His Messy Family When They Have Nowhere To Go
item.description: When her brother-in-law found himself homeless, she didn't think twice about letting him and his family move in temporarily. But things quickly went south. Not only did the BIL stop paying towards electricity, food and water, but his teenage stepdaughter turned the house into a pig-sty. The woman has told the family to leave, despite knowing they'll be forced to sleep in their car.
